en: Sekkhattika (The Triplet on the State of Being a Trainee)
Dependent on a state appertaining to one beyond training, a state appertaining to one beyond training arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. In the case of root, there are eighteen;
in the case of object, nine ... pe ... in the case of repetition, six ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance, eighteen.
